name: Jeeves Watcher
description: Semantic search, metadata enrichment, and instance administration for a jeeves-watcher deployment.

apiKey.description: Bearer key sent as Authorization: Bearer <key> on every watcher API request; must match the service's api.apiKey. Falls back to the JEEVES_WATCHER_API_KEY env var. Unset: no header.

configRoot.description: Platform config root path (e.g. /srv/jeeves/config). No default: set it here (jeeves install --config-root) or via the JEEVES_CONFIG_ROOT env var.

apiKey.label: Watcher API key
apiKey.help: Sent as a bearer token; matches the service's api.apiKey. Leave unset when the API has no key.
